findings.claim: Avoid logging raw subcommand input. `subcommand` is user-provided; echoing it directly can leak plaintext if sensitive data is pasted by mistake.
Add error handling and fix variable shadowing in `login()`. Lines 8 and 20 can reject without a catch block. If line 20 rejects, the spinner started at line 19 is never stopped.

Avoid `process.exit()` in helper and avoid raw error-message logging. Line 38 hard-exits from a reusable helper, which makes orchestration brittle. Line 37 logs uncontrolled `error.message`; prefer a sanitized message and throw a typed error for the caller to handle.
Use one CLI invocation style consistently. Line 497 switches to `npx `@cipherstash/stack` auth login` while the rest of the doc uses `npx stash ...`.
